Sardar G Ubtan Face Wash - Natural Glow & Spot-Free Skin
Sardar G Ubtan Face Wash aap ki jild ko Qudrati aur Traditional Ubtan ke khawaas se nikharta hai. Turmeric (Haldi), Saffron (Zafran), aur Qudrati ajzaa se tayyar karda yeh face wash jild se gandagi, oil aur dead skin cells ko gehraai se saaf karta hai.
Yeh chehre ki rangat ko saaf, roshan aur daag-dhabbon se paak kar ke aik qadimi aur qudrati chamak (Traditional Glow) deta hai.
Key Benefits (Khususiyaat aur Fawaid):
* Qudrati Nikhar (Instant Natural Glow): Zafran aur Haldi ke khawaas chehre ko bina kisi chemical ke qudrati chamak aur nikhar dete hain.
* Gehri Safai (Deep Pore Cleansing): Jild ke masamon (pores) se oilyness, dhool-matti aur zard-pan ko mukammal taur par khatam karta hai.
* Sun Tan Aur Chhaeyon Se Nijat: Dhoop se jhulasi hui jild (Sun Tan) ko repair karta hai aur pigmentation ko halka karta hai.
* Daane Aur Acne Se Hafazat: Haldi ke anti-bacterial khawaas daano (pimples) ko banne se rokte hain.
* Naram Aur Smooth Jild: Jild ki nami ko qaim rakhte hue use naram, mulaim aur fresh banata hai.

1. Chehra Geela Karein: Apne chehre ko taaza paani se halka geela kar lein.
2. Face Wash Lagayein: Hathéli par thodi si miqdar mein Ubtan Face Wash lein aur jhaag banayein.
3. Halka Massage Karein: Chehre aur gardan par 1-2 minute tak halkay haath se circular motion mein massage karein, khas taur par T-zone (peshani aur naak) par.

Product Description
Glowing skin begins with the right care. The Glow Combo brings together two natural essentials – coconut oil for deep nourishment and spotless radiance, and ubtan dry face wash for gentle daily cleansing.
Together, they help fade dark spots, even skin tone, and reveal a flawless natural glow you’ll love every day.
How to Use – Mix & Glow Method
1. Pre-Cleanse with Coconut Oil:
* Apply a few drops of coconut oil to your face and gently massage in circular motions for 2–3 minutes.
* Leave for 5–10 minutes to allow deep nourishment.
2. Cleanse with Ubtan Dry Face Wash:
* Mix 1–2 tsp of ubtan powder with water, milk, or rose water to form a paste.
* Apply over the oiled skin and massage gently for 1–2 minutes.
* Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
3. Finish:
* Pat dry and notice the skin’s softness and glow.
* Use 2–3 times a week for skin that’s nourished, radiant, and flawless. Key Ingredients

Why We Created The Glow Ritual
We wanted a two-step ritual that brings nourishing coconut care and traditional ubtan cleansing together without making the routine feel complicated.
So we paired Cold-Pressed Coconut Oil with Ubtan Face Wash to give skin two distinct, complementary steps: nourish first, then cleanse fresh.

How do I use the Glow Combo as a cleansing ritual? + -
Massage a few drops of Coconut Oil onto the face, leave it for 5 to 10 minutes, then cleanse with a paste made from Ubtan Face Wash and water.
How do I prepare the Ubtan Face Wash? + -
Mix 1 to 2 teaspoons with enough water to form a soft, spreadable paste.
Add liquid gradually so the mixture does not become runny.
Can I mix the ubtan with rose water, milk, or curd? + -
Yes, the published directions allow water, rose water, milk, buttermilk, or curd. Choose a mixer your skin already tolerates and patch test first.
Can I use Ubtan Face Wash without Coconut Oil? + -
Yes.
It can be mixed with water and used as a standalone rinse-off cleanser on damp skin.
